_comment: Machine-readable index of Hermes plugins maintained by rarf. install.sh reads this. Each plugin keeps its OWN repo (per-plugin history/PRs) — the hub only clones/updates them into HERMES_HOME/plugins/<path>. Do NOT use git submodules here; that would fold plugin history into the hub and break the standalone-repo guarantee. New fields vs the original: 'depends_on' (install-order prereqs, topologically sorted by install.sh), 'lifecycle' (stable|active|experimental — install.sh skips experimental unless --all), 'tracked_by_prs' (links to prs.json unmerged-PR entries).

plugins.description: Local permanent memory provider (append-only LOG + decay-compressed TREE, accent-normalized BM25 recall). Zero deps, native Windows.

local_installation.note: Verified directory install. Remote main is unchanged; do not replace this pin via the legacy main-branch hub installer before merge/release approval.

plugins.description: Personal operating system plugin: domains, objectives, KRs, projects, tasks, events + Dashboard UI. Private user-space layer (Option A), not a Hermes core fork.
Per-provider LLM quota / rate-limit footer block + /quota slash & CLI command.
